name: drawer
description: A swipeable drawer on Reka UI's native Drawer

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { DrawerRoot, type DrawerOpenChangeDetails, type DrawerRootEmits, type DrawerRootProps } from 'reka-ui'

// Reka's native Drawer (2.10+) replaces vaul-vue. The vaul-era props below are
// still accepted so existing code keeps working: `direction` maps to Reka's
// `swipeDirection`, `activeSnapPoint` to `snapPoint`, and `dismissible: false`
// cancels swipe / outside / Escape closes.
interface Props extends DrawerRootProps {
  /** @deprecated use `swipeDirection` (`down` | `up` | `left` | `right`). */
  direction?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'
  /** @deprecated use `snapPoint` (v-model:snap-point). */
  activeSnapPoint?: number | string | null
  dismissible?: boolean
  /** @deprecated vaul-only; Reka handles these itself. Accepted and ignored. */
  shouldScaleBackground?: boolean
  /** @deprecated */ fadeFromIndex?: number
  /** @deprecated */ closeThreshold?: number
  /** @deprecated */ handleOnly?: boolean
  /** @deprecated nesting is detected automatically */ nested?: boolean
  /** @deprecated */ fixed?: boolean
  /** @deprecated */ noBodyStyles?: boolean
}

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  open: undefined,
  defaultOpen: undefined,
  modal: true,
  dismissible: true,
  snapPoint: undefined,
  activeSnapPoint: undefined,
})

const emit = defineEmits<DrawerRootEmits & {
  'update:activeSnapPoint': [value: number | string | null]
}>()

const DIRECTION = { top: 'up', bottom: 'down', left: 'left', right: 'right' } as const

const swipeDirection = computed(() =>
  props.swipeDirection ?? (props.direction ? DIRECTION[props.direction] : 'down'),
)
const snapPoint = computed(() => props.snapPoint !== undefined ? props.snapPoint : props.activeSnapPoint)

const USER_DISMISS = new Set(['swipe', 'escape-key', 'outside-press'])

function onOpenUpdate(value: boolean, details: DrawerOpenChangeDetails) {
  if (!value && !props.dismissible && details.reason && USER_DISMISS.has(details.reason)) {
    details.cancel()
    return
  }
  emit('update:open', value, details)
}

function onSnapUpdate(value: number | string | null) {
  emit('update:snapPoint', value)
  emit('update:activeSnapPoint', value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerRoot
    :open="props.open"
    :default-open="props.defaultOpen"
    :modal="props.modal"
    :swipe-direction="swipeDirection"
    :snap-points="props.snapPoints"
    :snap-point="snapPoint"
    :default-snap-point="props.defaultSnapPoint"
    :snap-to-sequential-points="props.snapToSequentialPoints"
    @update:open="onOpenUpdate"
    @update:open-complete="emit('update:openComplete', $event)"
    @update:snap-point="onSnapUpdate"
  >
    <template #default="slotProps">
      <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
  </DrawerRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DrawerTrigger as DrawerTriggerPrimitive } from 'reka-ui'
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerTriggerPrimitive as-child>
    <slot />
  </DrawerTriggerPrimitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DrawerPortal, DrawerOverlay, DrawerContent as DrawerContentPrimitive, type DrawerContentProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

// Reka's Drawer is headless: it reports the drag through
// --drawer-swipe-movement-{x,y} and the side through data-swipe-direction,
// so position, the slide and the follow-the-finger transform all live here.
const props = defineProps<DrawerContentProps & { class?: string }>()
const delegated = computed(() => {
  const { class: _, ...rest } = props
  return rest
})
const forwarded = useForwardProps(delegated)
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerPortal>
    <DrawerOverlay
      class="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0"
    />
    <DrawerContentPrimitive
      v-bind="forwarded"
      :class="
        cn(
          'group/drawer fixed z-50 flex flex-col border-foreground bg-background outline-none',
          'translate-x-[var(--drawer-swipe-movement-x,0px)] translate-y-[var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y,0px)] transition-transform duration-300 ease-[var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1))] data-[swiping]:duration-0',
          'data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=open]:duration-300 data-[state=closed]:duration-200',
          'data-[swipe-direction=down]:inset-x-0 data-[swipe-direction=down]:bottom-0 data-[swipe-direction=down]:mt-24 data-[swipe-direction=down]:max-h-[85vh] data-[swipe-direction=down]:border-3 data-[swipe-direction=down]:border-b-0 data-[swipe-direction=down]:shadow-[0px_-8px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[swipe-direction=down]:data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-bottom data-[swipe-direction=down]:data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-bottom',
          'data-[swipe-direction=up]:inset-x-0 data-[swipe-direction=up]:top-0 data-[swipe-direction=up]:mb-24 data-[swipe-direction=up]:max-h-[85vh] data-[swipe-direction=up]:border-3 data-[swipe-direction=up]:border-t-0 data-[swipe-direction=up]:shadow-[0px_8px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[swipe-direction=up]:data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top data-[swipe-direction=up]:data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-top',
          'data-[swipe-direction=left]:inset-y-0 data-[swipe-direction=left]:left-0 data-[swipe-direction=left]:w-3/4 data-[swipe-direction=left]:sm:max-w-sm data-[swipe-direction=left]:border-3 data-[swipe-direction=left]:border-l-0 data-[swipe-direction=left]:shadow-[8px_0px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[swipe-direction=left]:data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left data-[swipe-direction=left]:data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left',
          'data-[swipe-direction=right]:inset-y-0 data-[swipe-direction=right]:right-0 data-[swipe-direction=right]:w-3/4 data-[swipe-direction=right]:sm:max-w-sm data-[swipe-direction=right]:border-3 data-[swipe-direction=right]:border-r-0 data-[swipe-direction=right]:shadow-[-8px_0px_0px_hsl(var(--shadow-color))] data-[swipe-direction=right]:data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-right data-[swipe-direction=right]:data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right',
          props.class,
        )
      "
    >
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        class="mx-auto mt-4 hidden h-2 w-[100px] shrink-0 bg-foreground group-data-[swipe-direction=down]/drawer:block"
      />
      <slot />
    </DrawerContentPrimitive>
  </DrawerPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DrawerTitle as DrawerTitlePrimitive } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineProps<{
  class?: string
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerTitlePrimitive
    :class="cn('text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-wide leading-none', $props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </DrawerTitlePrimitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DrawerDescription as DrawerDescriptionPrimitive } from 'reka-ui'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

defineProps<{
  class?: string
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerDescriptionPrimitive :class="cn('text-sm text-muted-foreground', $props.class)">
    <slot />
  </DrawerDescriptionPrimitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { DrawerClose as DrawerClosePrimitive } from 'reka-ui'
</script>

<template>
  <DrawerClosePrimitive as-child>
    <slot />
  </DrawerClosePrimitive>
</template>
